items.title: What Is Blackstone (BX) Signaling With Its $5 Billion Data Center Deal?
items.summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) has agreed for its Digital Infrastructure Trust to acquire a US$5b AWS data center portfolio backed by Amazon Web Services. The portfolio consists of hyperscale facilities used by AWS, giving Blackstone exposure to large scale cloud and AI infrastructure. Long term agreements with Amazon Web Services are designed to provide contracted revenue visibility for the acquired data centers. items.title: Private Equity and Private Credit Firms Manage Trillions, and $90,000 Across These 3 Pays $3,389 a Year in Dividends
items.summary: Private funds usually demand millions and years of locked-up cash, yet the firms running them trade like ordinary stocks. Three of these managers pass fee income to shareholders, but one dividend barely clears its earnings, and another changes every quarter.
